name: @almostjacked/health-mcp
description: Your health data (weight, macros, weigh-ins) as MCP tools — in your own Supabase, zero custody.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-functions.mjs
scripts.prepack: node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-functions.mjs
scripts.build:mcpb: node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=mcpb/server/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && mcpb pack mcpb health-mcp.mcpb

author: AJ Wallace <ajwallacemusic@gmail.com>
